description: A 3HP clock divider with five gate outputs, each running at half the rate of the one before; it counts downwards so that all five start together

inputs.text: Each rise above 0V steps the divider on
A rise above 0V returns the divider to its starting state

outputs.text: 10V for one clock and 0V for the next, so half the clock rate
10V for two clocks and 0V for two, so a quarter of the clock rate
10V for four clocks and 0V for four, so an eighth of the clock rate
10V for eight clocks and 0V for eight, so a sixteenth of the clock rate
10V for sixteen clocks and 0V for sixteen, so a thirty-second of the clock rate

notes: Mono only: a polyphonic cable patched in is read as its first channel alone, and each output carries one channel
